sql: SELECT T1.W FROM TeamVsTeam AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.name = 'Philadelphia Flyers' AND T1.oppID = 'BOS' AND T1.year = 1985

SELECT T3.name FROM TeamVsTeam AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.year = T3.year AND T1.oppID = T3.tmID WHERE T2.name = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND T1.year = 2000 ORDER BY T1.W + T1.L + COALESCE(T1.T, 0) + COALESCE(T1.OTL, 0) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.PIM FROM TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.year = 1918
SELECT T1.W FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T2.PIM = 24
SELECT SUM(CAST(T2.W AS REAL) / T2.G) / COUNT(T2.G) FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.birthCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.coachID) FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T3.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.coachID IS NOT NULL AND T1.hofID IS NULL AND T2.year = 1972 AND T2.tmID = 'BOS'

SELECT T1.playerID FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.name = 'Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY SUM(CAST(T1.GA AS INTEGER)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2005 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2006 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2005 THEN CAST(T1.GP AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.firstName = 'David' AND T2.lastName = 'Aebischer'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT (SELECT SUM(Pts) FROM Teams WHERE tmID = 'ANA'), T.coachID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coachID FROM Coaches WHERE tmID = 'ANA') AS T

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.tmID FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND T1.playerID = (SELECT M.playerID FROM Master AS M INNER JOIN Scoring AS S ON M.playerID = S.playerID WHERE S.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND M.height IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(M.height AS INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CAST(T1.W AS REAL) / T1.G, T2.playerID FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.tmID = 'CAR' AND T1.year = 1998 ORDER BY T2.G DESC LIMIT 1
